QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_17

question.text: As the Manager of a newly launched Cat III AIF, your checklist of general obligations must include appointing a CUSTODIAN. This requirement applies:

answer.text: Only if fund corpus exceeds INR 500 crore
Only if the fund holds listed securities, not unlisted
For all AIFs — the Sponsor or Investment Manager shall appoint a SEBI-registered custodian for safekeeping of securities/goods
Only for Cat III AIFs; Cat I and II are exempt

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the Sponsor or Investment Manager shall appoint a SEBI-registered custodian for the safekeeping of securities/goods, and that appointing a custodian is mandatory for all AIFs. There is no corpus threshold, listed/unlisted carve-out or category-based exemption from this requirement, and per-scheme segregation of assets is required separately. The Trap: Corpus and listed-only carve-outs are not supported by the workbook. The Cat-III-only restriction is a popular distractor based on leverage concerns, but Categories I and II also require custodians. Note: Source pages 357-358 and 489 support the all-AIF custodian requirement and SEBI-registered custodian wording; page 427 supports per-scheme segregation.
